name: Marvon's Workshop
summary: Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop is in Ratchet, but he has been away for a long time. He went to Tanaris to study ancient troll ruins.

sections.title: At the Workshop
sections.body: In Ratchet, Marvon Rivetseeker's workshop is where you are asked to go. Marvon has been gone for a long time, having traveled to Tanaris to study ancient troll ruins.
